scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:browser && npm run typecheck:tooling
scripts.build:runtime: npm run compile:tooling && npm run compile:browser && node .build/tooling/scripts/sync-runtime.js
scripts.validate: npm run build:runtime && node .build/tooling/scripts/validate-source-boundary.js && node .build/tooling/scripts/validate-overrides.js && node .build/tooling/scripts/validate-production-boundary.js && node .build/tooling/scripts/validate-responsive-contract.js
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run validate && npm run build:pages
